Definition: fulness of the breast; also a moving creature
BiblicalUsage: Ziyz means the moving creatures — the wild things of the field that belong to God in Psalm 50 — and it also means abundance or fullness, the plenty of Jerusalem's consolations in Isaiah 66. In Psalm 80 the boar from the wood devours the vine, a moving creature turned destroyer. One word holds both the creatures God owns and the fullness He gives.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that everything that moves and everything that satisfies belongs to the Lord, and that is why both the beast and the abundance answer to Him.
